Social History: Software engineer. Non-smoker. Alcohol: 2–4 drinks per week socially. Exercises 3–4 times per week (running and weight training). Balanced diet with moderate red-meat intake. Sleep averages 6.5–7 hours nightly.

Laboratory Results: CBC within normal limits (WBC 5.8, Hemoglobin 15.2 g/dL, Platelets 245). Metabolic panel normal (Sodium 140, Potassium 4.2, Creatinine 0.98 mg/dL, eGFR 104, AST 22, ALT 26). Assessment: Generally healthy adult male. LDL cholesterol slightly elevated. Allergic rhinitis stable.
